description: Structured eval definitions for the S3 Secure Bucket Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across workload types (compliance, data-lake, CDN, backup+DR) and missing-prerequisite branches. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Compliance-grade bucket with full security baseline + MFA Delete
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, SSE-KMS + MFA Delete + lifecycle
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a production S3 bucket named "compliance-archive-2024" in us-east-1 for compliance workloads (HIPAA). Use SSE-KMS with customer-managed CMK (alias/compliance-s3-key), enable versioning with MFA delete, access logging to "s3-access-logs-prod", CloudTrail data events on trail "aws-controltower-trail", lifecycle: STANDARD_IA@30d then GLACIER@90d then DEEP_ARCHIVE@365d, expire noncurrent versions at 180d. Tags: Environment=production, DataClassification=phi. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: compliance-archive-2024
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]        Block Public Access — bucket level (all 4 settings)
  [✓]        Block Public Access — account level (defense-in-depth)
  [✓]        Default encryption — SSE-KMS (alias/compliance-s3-key, BucketKeyEnabled)
  [✓]        Object Ownership — BucketOwnerEnforced (ACLs disabled)
  [✓]        Versioning — Enabled
  [✓]        MFA Delete — Enabled (compliance workload)
  [✓]        Bucket policy — HTTPS-only + SSE-KMS upload enforcement
  [✓]        Access logging — Target: s3-access-logs-prod
  [✓]        CloudTrail data events — Trail: aws-controltower-trail
  [✓]        Lifecycle — STANDARD_IA@30d → GLACIER@90d → DEEP_ARCHIVE@365d, expire noncurrent@180d
  [OPTIONAL] Replication — Not configured
  [✓]        Tags — Environment=production, DataClassification=phi
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket compliance-archive-2024
  aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket compliance-archive-2024
  aws s3api get-bucket-ownership-controls --bucket compliance-archive-2024

eval_cases.name: Legacy bucket missing BPA and Object Ownership — needs hardening
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — bucket exists but lacks BPA and ownership controls
eval_cases.prompt: We created a bucket "legacy-app-data" last year and just realized it has no Block Public Access configured, no Object Ownership setting, and no bucket policy. It does have SSE-S3 default encryption and versioning. Help me get this to production-ready security baseline. Region: us-west-2, Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: legacy-app-data
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗]      Block Public Access — bucket level (NOT configured — enable immediately)
  [✗]      Object Ownership — NOT set (defaults to ObjectWriter, ACLs honored)
  [✓]      Default encryption — SSE-S3 (AES256)
  [✓]      Versioning — Enabled
  [✗]      Bucket policy — NOT configured (no HTTPS enforcement)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket legacy-app-data
  aws s3api get-bucket-ownership-controls --bucket legacy-app-data
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket legacy-app-data

eval_cases.name: Data lake bucket with INTELLIGENT_TIERING lifecycle
eval_cases.prompt: Create a data lake landing zone bucket named "datalake-raw-zone" in us-east-1. Use SSE-KMS with alias/datalake-kms-key. Enable Intelligent-Tiering for the lifecycle (unknown access patterns). Enable access logging to "datalake-logs". Versioning on. No replication needed. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=data-lake, Zone=raw. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: datalake-raw-zone
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]        Block Public Access — bucket level (all 4 settings)
  [✓]        Default encryption — SSE-KMS (alias/datalake-kms-key, BucketKeyEnabled)
  [✓]        Object Ownership — BucketOwnerEnforced
  [✓]        Versioning — Enabled
  [✓]        Bucket policy — HTTPS-only + SSE-KMS enforcement
  [✓]        Lifecycle — INTELLIGENT_TIERING (auto-tiering for unknown access patterns)
  [OPTIONAL] Replication — Not configured
  [✓]        Tags — Environment=production, Workload=data-lake, Zone=raw
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket datalake-raw-zone
  aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket datalake-raw-zone

eval_cases.name: CDN static assets bucket with SSE-S3 (no KMS, no lifecycle)
eval_cases.prompt: Create an S3 bucket for static website assets served via CloudFront. Name: "cdn-assets-prod", region: us-east-1. This is a CDN origin so it will be accessed frequently. Use SSE-S3 encryption (cost-sensitive, not compliance data). No lifecycle needed (frequently accessed). Access logging to "s3-access-logs-prod". Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: cdn-assets-prod
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]        Block Public Access — bucket level (all 4 settings)
  [✓]        Default encryption — SSE-S3 (AES256)
  [✓]        Object Ownership — BucketOwnerEnforced
  [OPTIONAL] Versioning — Suspended (frequently overwritten CDN assets)
  [✓]        Bucket policy — HTTPS-only enforcement
  [✓]        Access logging — Target: s3-access-logs-prod
  [OPTIONAL] Lifecycle — Not configured (frequently accessed via CloudFront)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket cdn-assets-prod
  aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket cdn-assets-prod

eval_cases.name: Production backup bucket with CRR + MFA Delete + full lifecycle
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all items including CRR replication + MFA Delete
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a production backup bucket named "prod-backup-primary" in us-east-1 with CRR to "prod-backup-dr" in us-west-2. Use SSE-KMS (alias/prod-backup-key in us-east-1, alias/prod-backup-key-dr in us-west-2). Enable MFA delete, versioning, lifecycle: GLACIER@90d then DEEP_ARCHIVE@180d, expire noncurrent@365d. Access logging to "s3-access-logs-prod". CloudTrail data events on trail "management-trail". Tags: Environment=production, Workload=backup. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: prod-backup-primary
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Block Public Access — bucket level (all 4 settings)
  [✓]      Block Public Access — account level (defense-in-depth)
  [✓]      Default encryption — SSE-KMS (alias/prod-backup-key, BucketKeyEnabled)
  [✓]      Object Ownership — BucketOwnerEnforced
  [✓]      Versioning — Enabled
  [✓]      MFA Delete — Enabled (backup workload)
  [✓]      Bucket policy — HTTPS-only + SSE-KMS enforcement
  [✓]      Access logging — Target: s3-access-logs-prod
  [✓]      CloudTrail data events — Trail: management-trail
  [✓]      Lifecycle — GLACIER@90d → DEEP_ARCHIVE@180d, expire noncurrent@365d
  [✓]      Replication — CRR to prod-backup-dr in us-west-2
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Workload=backup
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket prod-backup-primary
  aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket prod-backup-primary
  aws s3api get-bucket-replication --bucket prod-backup-primary
